sequence_metadata.description: Recommended task implementation order considering dependencies, priorities, and logical grouping

implementation_phases.phase_description: Establish core infrastructure and foundational components that other tasks depend on

tasks.title: Implement Input Validation Module
tasks.rationale: Critical dependency for multiple high-priority tasks. Must be completed first.

tasks.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
tasks.rationale: Essential for setup and onboarding. Can be done in parallel with TASK-003.

tasks.title: Add ESLint and Prettier Configuration
tasks.rationale: Establishes code quality standards early. Can be done in parallel.

tasks.title: Add Type Definitions
tasks.rationale: Improves developer experience and code documentation. Independent task.

implementation_phases.phase_description: Build robust error handling and reliability features

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
tasks.rationale: High priority, depends on validation module. Part of critical path.

tasks.title: Implement Logging Framework
tasks.rationale: Improves debugging and monitoring. Can run parallel with error handling implementation.

tasks.title: Add Retry Mechanism for API Calls
tasks.rationale: Depends on error handling. Critical for reliability.

implementation_phases.phase_description: Expand core functionality with retrieval, updates, and bug fixes

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
tasks.rationale: High priority feature enhancement. Enables querying capabilities.

tasks.title: Fix Assigned To Field Implementation
tasks.rationale: High priority bug fix. Resolves existing implementation issue.

tasks.title: Enhance README Documentation
tasks.rationale: High priority documentation. Now has complete information after core features.

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Functionality
tasks.rationale: Completes CRUD operations. Depends on retrieval functionality.

tasks.title: Create Unit Test Suite
tasks.rationale: High priority. Core features now stable enough to test. Critical path item.

tasks.title: Create Integration Test Suite
tasks.rationale: Builds on unit tests. Validates end-to-end functionality.

tasks.title: Add CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
tasks.rationale: Automates testing. Depends on test suite being complete.

tasks.title: Create CLI Interface
tasks.rationale: Medium priority enhancement. All core features now available.

tasks.title: Add Rate Limiting Awareness
tasks.rationale: Important for production reliability. Depends on retry mechanism.

tasks.title: Implement Batch Operations Support
tasks.rationale: Advanced feature. Requires validation and retry mechanisms.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Management
tasks.rationale: Architectural improvement. Can be added at any point.

tasks.title: Refactor Main Function to Examples
tasks.rationale: Code organization cleanup. Low priority.

tasks.title: Create Contributing Guidelines
tasks.rationale: Final documentation. Code standards now established.
